entry: Swanna start to dance at dusk. The one dancing in the middle is the leader of the flock.

name: vanillite
entry: The temperature of their breath is -58° F. They create snow crystals and make snow fall in the areas around them.

name: vanillish
entry: Snowy mountains are this Pokémon’s habitat. During an ancient ice age, they moved to southern areas.

name: vanilluxe
entry: Swallowing large amounts of water, they make snow clouds inside their bodies and attack their foes with violent blizzards.

name: deerling
entry: The color and scent of their fur changes to match the mountain grass. When they sense hostility, they hide in the grass.

name: sawsbuck
entry: They migrate according to the seasons. People can tell the season by looking at Sawsbuck’s horns.

name: emolga
entry: The energy made in its cheeks’ electric pouches is stored inside its membrane and released while it is gliding.

name: karrablast
entry: These mysterious Pokémon evolve when they receive electrical stimulation while they are in the same place as Shelmet.

name: escavalier
entry: They fly around at high speed, striking with their pointed spears. Even when in trouble, they face opponents bravely.

name: foongus
entry: It lures people in with its Poké Ball pattern, then releases poison spores. Why it resembles a Poké Ball is unknown.

name: amoonguss
entry: It lures prey close by dancing and waving its arm caps, which resemble Poké Balls, in a swaying motion.

name: frillish-male
entry: With its thin, veil-like arms wrapped around the body of its opponent, it sinks to the ocean floor.

name: jellicent-male
entry: The fate of the ships and crew that wander into Jellicent’s habitat: all sunken, all lost, all vanished.

name: alomomola
entry: The special membrane enveloping Alomomola has the ability to heal wounds.

name: joltik
entry: Joltik that live in cities have learned a technique for sucking electricity from the outlets in houses.

name: galvantula
entry: When attacked, they create an electric barrier by spitting out many electrically charged threads.

name: ferroseed
entry: When threatened, it attacks by shooting a barrage of spikes, which gives it a chance to escape by rolling away.

name: ferrothorn
entry: It fights by swinging around its three spiky feelers. A hit from these steel spikes can reduce a boulder to rubble.

name: klink
entry: The two minigears that mesh together are predetermined. Each will rebound from other minigears without meshing.

name: klang
entry: By changing the direction in which it rotates, it communicates its feelings to others. When angry, it rotates faster.

name: klinklang
entry: Its red core functions as an energy tank. It fires the charged energy through its spikes into an area.

name: tynamo
entry: While one alone doesn’t have much power, a chain of many Tynamo can be as powerful as lightning.

name: eelektrik
entry: They coil around foes and shock them with electricity-generating organs that seem simply to be circular patterns.

name: eelektross
entry: They crawl out of the ocean using their arms. They will attack prey on shore and immediately drag it into the ocean.

name: elgyem
entry: It uses its strong psychic power to squeeze its opponent’s brain, causing unendurable headaches.

name: beheeyem
entry: It can manipulate an opponent’s memory. Apparently, it communicates by flashing its three different-colored fingers.

name: litwick
entry: Litwick shines a light that absorbs the life energy of people and Pokémon, which becomes the fuel that it burns.

name: lampent
entry: This ominous Pokémon is feared. Through cities it wanders, searching for the spirits of the fallen.

name: chandelure
entry: It absorbs a spirit, which it then burns. By waving the flames on its arms, it puts its foes into a hypnotic trance.

name: axew
entry: They use their tusks to crush the berries they eat. Repeated regrowth makes their tusks strong and sharp.

name: fraxure
entry: Since a broken tusk will not grow back, they diligently sharpen their tusks on river rocks after they’ve been fighting.

name: haxorus
entry: They are kind but can be relentless when defending territory. They challenge foes with tusks that can cut steel.

name: cubchoo
entry: When it is not feeling well, its mucus gets watery and the power of its Ice-type moves decreases.

name: beartic
entry: It can make its breath freeze at will. Very able in the water, it swims around in northern seas and catches prey.

name: cryogonal
entry: When its body temperature goes up, it turns into steam and vanishes. When its temperature lowers, it returns to ice.

name: shelmet
entry: When attacked, it defends itself by closing the lid of its shell. It can spit a sticky, poisonous liquid.

name: accelgor
entry: When its body dries out, it weakens. So, to prevent dehydration, it wraps itself in many layers of thin membrane.

name: stunfisk
entry: Its skin is very hard, so it is unhurt even if stepped on by sumo wrestlers. It smiles when transmitting electricity.

name: mienfoo
entry: In fights, they dominate with onslaughts of flowing, continuous attacks. With their sharp claws, they cut enemies.

name: mienshao
entry: It wields the fur on its arms like a whip. Its arm attacks come with such rapidity that they cannot even be seen.

name: druddigon
entry: It warms its body by absorbing sunlight with its wings. When its body temperature falls, it can no longer move.

name: golett
entry: The energy that burns inside it enables it to move, but no one has yet been able to identify this energy.

name: golurk
entry: It flies across the sky at Mach speeds. Removing the seal on its chest makes its internal energy go out of control.

name: pawniard
entry: Blades comprise this Pokémon’s entire body. If battling dulls the blades, it sharpens them on stones by the river.

name: bisharp
entry: It leads a group of Pawniard. It battles to become the boss, but will be driven from the group if it loses.

name: bouffalant
entry: Their fluffy fur absorbs damage, even if they strike foes with a fierce headbutt.

name: rufflet
entry: They crush berries with their talons. They bravely stand up to any opponent, no matter how strong it is.

name: braviary
entry: They fight for their friends without any thought about danger to themselves. One can carry a car while flying.

name: vullaby
entry: Its wings are too tiny to allow it to fly. As the time approaches for it to evolve, it discards the bones it was wearing.

name: mandibuzz
entry: It makes a nest out of bones it finds. It grabs weakened prey in its talons and hauls it to its nest of bones.

name: heatmor
entry: It breathes through a hole in its tail while it burns with an internal fire. Durant is its prey.

name: durant
entry: They attack in groups, covering themselves in steel armor to protect themselves from Heatmor.

name: deino
entry: It tends to bite everything, and it is not a picky eater. Approaching it carelessly is dangerous.

name: zweilous
entry: After it has eaten up all the food in its territory, it moves to another area. Its two heads do not get along.

name: hydreigon
entry: This brutal Pokémon travels the skies on its six wings. Anything that moves seems like a foe to it, triggering its attack.

name: larvesta
entry: This Pokémon was believed to have been born from the sun. When it evolves, its entire body is engulfed in flames.

name: volcarona
entry: When volcanic ash darkened the atmosphere, it is said that Volcarona’s fire provided a replacement for the sun.

name: cobalion
entry: This legendary Pokémon battled against humans to protect Pokémon. Its personality is calm and composed.

name: terrakion
entry: This Pokémon came to the defense of Pokémon that had lost their homes in a war among humans.

name: virizion
entry: This Pokémon fought humans in order to protect its friends. Legends about it continue to be passed down.

name: tornadus-incarnate
entry: The lower half of its body is wrapped in a cloud of energy. It zooms through the sky at 200 mph.

name: thundurus-incarnate
entry: Countless charred remains mar the landscape of places through which Thundurus has passed.

name: reshiram
entry: This Pokémon appears in legends. It sends flames into the air from its tail, burning up everything around it.

name: zekrom
entry: Concealing itself in lightning clouds, it flies throughout the Unova region. It creates electricity in its tail.

name: landorus-incarnate
entry: Lands visited by Landorus grant such bountiful crops that it has been hailed as “The Guardian of the Fields.”

name: kyurem
entry: It can produce ultracold air. Its body is frozen.

name: keldeo-ordinary
entry: By blasting water from its hooves, it can glide across water. It excels at using leg moves while battling.

name: meloetta-aria
entry: Its melodies are sung with a special vocalization method that can control the feelings of those who hear it.

name: genesect
entry: Over 300 million years ago, it was feared as the strongest of hunters. It has been modified by Team Plasma.

name: chespin
entry: The quills on its head are usually soft. When it flexes them, the points become so hard and sharp that they can pierce rock.

name: quilladin
entry: It relies on its sturdy shell to deflect predators’ attacks. It counterattacks with its sharp quills.

name: chesnaught
entry: Its Tackle is forceful enough to flip a 50-ton tank. It shields its allies from danger with its own body.

name: fennekin
entry: Eating a twig fills it with energy, and its roomy ears give vent to air hotter than 390 degrees Fahrenheit.

name: braixen
entry: It has a twig stuck in its tail. With friction from its tail fur, it sets the twig on fire and launches into battle.

name: delphox
entry: It gazes into the flame at the tip of its branch to achieve a focused state, which allows it to see into the future.

name: froakie
entry: It secretes flexible bubbles from its chest and back. The bubbles reduce the damage it would otherwise take when attacked.

name: frogadier
entry: It can throw bubble-covered pebbles with precise control, hitting empty cans up to a hundred feet away.

name: greninja
entry: It creates throwing stars out of compressed water. When it spins them and throws them at high speed, these stars can split metal in two.

name: bunnelby
entry: They use their large ears to dig burrows. They will dig the whole night through.

name: diggersby
entry: With their powerful ears, they can heft boulders of a ton or more with ease. They can be a big help at construction sites.

name: fletchling
entry: These friendly Pokémon send signals to one another with beautiful chirps and tail-feather movements.

name: fletchinder
entry: From its beak, it expels embers that set the tall grass on fire. Then it pounces on the bewildered prey that pop out of the grass.

name: talonflame
entry: In the fever of an exciting battle, it showers embers from the gaps between its feathers and takes to the air.

name: scatterbug
entry: When under attack from bird Pokémon, it spews a poisonous black powder that causes paralysis on contact.

name: spewpa
entry: It lives hidden within thicket shadows. When predators attack, it quickly bristles the fur covering its body in an effort to threaten them.

name: vivillon
entry: Vivillon with many different patterns are found all over the world. These patterns are affected by the climate of their habitat.

name: litleo
entry: The stronger the opponent it faces, the more heat surges from its mane and the more power flows through its body.

name: pyroar-male
entry: The male with the largest mane of fire is the leader of the pride.

name: flabebe
entry: It draws out and controls the hidden power of flowers. The flower Flabébé holds is most likely part of its body.

name: floette
entry: It flutters around fields of flowers and cares for flowers that are starting to wilt. It draws out the hidden power of flowers to battle.

name: florges
entry: It claims exquisite flower gardens as its territory, and it obtains power from basking in the energy emitted by flowering plants.

name: skiddo
entry: Thought to be one of the first Pokémon to live in harmony with humans, it has a placid disposition.

name: gogoat
entry: It can tell how its Trainer is feeling by subtle shifts in the grip on its horns. This empathic sense lets them run as if one being.

name: pancham
entry: It does its best to be taken seriously by its enemies, but its glare is not sufficiently intimidating. Chewing on a leaf is its trademark.

name: pangoro
entry: Although it possesses a violent temperament, it won’t put up with bullying. It uses the leaf in its mouth to sense the movements of its enemies.

name: furfrou
entry: Trimming its fluffy fur not only makes it more elegant but also increases the swiftness of its movements.

name: espurr
entry: The organ that emits its intense psychic power is sheltered by its ears to keep power from leaking out.

name: meowstic-male
entry: When in danger, it raises its ears and releases enough psychic power to grind a 10-ton truck into dust.

name: honedge
entry: Apparently this Pokémon is born when a departed spirit inhabits a sword. It attaches itself to people and drinks their life force.

name: doublade
entry: When Honedge evolves, it divides into two swords, which cooperate via telepathy to coordinate attacks and slash their enemies to ribbons.

name: aegislash
entry: Generations of kings were attended by these Pokémon, which used their spectral power to manipulate and control people and Pokémon.

name: spritzee
entry: It emits a scent that enraptures those who smell it. This fragrance changes depending on what it has eaten.

name: aromatisse
entry: It devises various scents, pleasant and unpleasant, and emits scents that its enemies dislike in order to gain an edge in battle.

name: swirlix
entry: Because it eats nothing but sweets, its fur is as sticky sweet as cotton candy.

name: slurpuff
entry: It can distinguish the faintest of scents. It puts its sensitive sense of smell to use by helping pastry chefs in their work.

name: inkay
entry: Opponents who stare at the flashing of the light-emitting spots on its body become dazed and lose their will to fight.

name: malamar
entry: It wields the most compelling hypnotic powers of any Pokémon, and it forces others to do whatever it wants.

name: binacle
entry: Two Binacle live together on one rock. When they fight, one of them will move to a different rock.

name: barbaracle
entry: When they evolve, two Binacle multiply into seven. They fight with the power of seven Binacle.

name: skrelp
entry: Camouflaged as rotten kelp, they spray liquid poison on prey that approaches unawares and then finish it off.

name: dragalge
entry: Their poison is strong enough to eat through the hull of a tanker, and they spit it indiscriminately at anything that enters their territory.

name: clauncher
entry: They knock down flying prey by firing compressed water from their massive claws like shooting a pistol.

name: clawitzer
entry: Their enormous claws launch cannonballs of water powerful enough to pierce tanker hulls.

name: helioptile
entry: They make their home in deserts. They can generate their energy from basking in the sun, so eating food is not a requirement.

name: heliolisk
entry: They flare their frills and generate energy. A single Heliolisk can generate sufficient electricity to power a skyscraper.

name: tyrunt
entry: This Pokémon was restored from a fossil. If something happens that it doesn’t like, it throws a tantrum and runs wild.

name: tyrantrum
entry: Nothing could stop this Pokémon 100 million years ago, so it behaved like a king.

name: amaura
entry: This ancient Pokémon was restored from part of its body that had been frozen in ice for over 100 million years.

name: aurorus
entry: The diamond-shaped crystals on its body expel air as cold as -240 degrees Fahrenheit, surrounding its enemies and encasing them in ice.

name: sylveon
entry: It sends a soothing aura from its ribbonlike feelers to calm fights.

name: hawlucha
entry: Although its body is small, its proficient fighting skills enable it to keep up with big bruisers like Machamp and Hariyama.

name: dedenne
entry: Since Dedenne can’t generate much electricity on its own, it steals electricity from outlets or other electric Pokémon.

name: carbink
entry: Born from the temperatures and pressures deep underground, it fires beams from the stone in its head.

name: goomy
entry: The weakest Dragon-type Pokémon, it lives in damp, shady places, so its body doesn’t dry out.

name: sliggoo
entry: It drives away opponents by excreting a sticky liquid that can dissolve anything. Its eyes devolved, so it can’t see anything.

name: goodra
entry: This very friendly Dragon-type Pokémon will hug its beloved Trainer, leaving that Trainer covered in sticky slime.

name: klefki
entry: These key collectors threaten any attackers by fiercely jingling their keys at them.

name: phantump
entry: These Pokémon are created when spirits possess rotten tree stumps. They prefer to live in abandoned forests.

name: trevenant
entry: It can control trees at will. It will trap people who harm the forest, so they can never leave.

name: pumpkaboo-average
entry: The pumpkin body is inhabited by a spirit trapped in this world. As the sun sets, it becomes restless and active.

name: gourgeist-average
entry: Singing in eerie voices, they wander town streets on the night of the new moon. Anyone who hears their song is cursed.

name: bergmite
entry: It blocks opponents’ attacks with the ice that shields its body. It uses cold air to repair any cracks with new ice.

name: avalugg
entry: Its ice-covered body is as hard as steel. Its cumbersome frame crushes anything that stands in its way.

name: noibat
entry: They live in pitch-black caves. Their enormous ears can emit ultrasonic waves of 200,000 hertz.

name: noivern
entry: They fly around on moonless nights and attack careless prey. Nothing can beat them in a battle in the dark.

name: xerneas
entry: Legends say it can share eternal life. It slept for a thousand years in the form of a tree before its revival.

name: yveltal
entry: When this legendary Pokémon’s wings and tail feathers spread wide and glow red, it absorbs the life force of living creatures.

name: zygarde-50
entry: When the Kalos region’s ecosystem falls into disarray, it appears and reveals its secret power.

name: diancie
entry: A sudden transformation of Carbink, its pink, glimmering body is said to be the loveliest sight in the whole world.

name: hoopa
entry: This troublemaker sends anything and everything to faraway places using its loop, which can warp space.

name: volcanion
entry: It lets out billows of steam and disappears into the dense fog. It’s said to live in mountains where humans do not tread.

name: rowlet
entry: This wary Pokémon uses photosynthesis to store up energy during the day, while becoming active at night.

name: dartrix
entry: A bit of a dandy, it spends its free time preening its wings. Its preoccupation with any dirt on its plumage can leave it unable to battle.

name: decidueye
entry: It fires arrow quills from its wings with such precision, they can pierce a pebble at distances over a hundred yards.

name: litten
entry: While grooming itself, it builds up fur inside its stomach. It sets the fur alight and spews fiery attacks, which change based on how it coughs.

name: torracat
entry: At its throat, it bears a bell of fire. The bell rings brightly whenever this Pokémon spits fire.

name: incineroar
entry: This Pokémon has a violent, selfish disposition. If it’s not in the mood to listen, it will ignore its Trainer’s orders with complete nonchalance.

name: popplio
entry: This Pokémon snorts body fluids from its nose, blowing balloons to smash into its foes. It’s famous for being a hard worker.

name: brionne
entry: A skillful dancer, it creates a sequence of water balloons as it dances, and briskly bombards its enemies.

name: primarina
entry: It controls its water balloons with song. The melody is learned from others of its kind and is passed down from one generation to the next.

name: pikipek
entry: It can peck at a rate of 16 times a second to drill holes in trees. It uses the holes for food storage and for nesting.

name: trumbeak
entry: It eats berries and stores their seeds in its beak. When it encounters enemies or prey, it fires off all the seeds in a burst.

name: toucannon
entry: When it battles, its beak heats up. The temperature can easily exceed 212 degrees Fahrenheit, causing severe burns when it hits.

name: yungoos
entry: With its sharp fangs, it will bite anything. It did not originally live in Alola but was imported from another region.

name: gumshoos
entry: When it finds a trace of its prey, it patiently stakes out the location...but it’s always snoozing by nightfall.

name: grubbin
entry: Its strong jaw enables it to scrape trees and slurp out the sap. It normally lives underground.

name: charjabug
entry: Its body is capable of storing electricity. On camping trips, people are grateful to have one around.

name: vikavolt
entry: It zips around, on sharp lookout for an opening. It concentrates electrical energy within its large jaws and uses it to zap its enemies.

name: crabrawler
entry: While guarding its weak points with its pincers, it looks for an opening and unleashes punches. When it loses, it foams at the mouth and faints.

name: crabominable
entry: It aimed for the top but got lost and ended up on a snowy mountain. Being forced to endure the cold, this Pokémon evolved and grew fur.

name: oricorio-baile
entry: It beats its wings together to create fire. As it moves in the steps of its beautiful dance, it bathes opponents in intense flames.

name: cutiefly
entry: It feeds on the nectar and pollen of flowers. Because it’s able to sense auras, it can identify which flowers are about to bloom.

name: ribombee
entry: It rolls up pollen into puffs. It makes many different varieties, some used as food and others used in battle.

name: rockruff
entry: It’s considered to be a good Pokémon for beginners because of its friendliness, but its disposition grows rougher as it grows up.

name: lycanroc-midday
entry: Its quick movements confuse its enemies. Well equipped with claws and fangs, it also uses the sharp rocks in its mane as weapons.

name: wishiwashi
entry: When it’s in trouble, its eyes moisten and begin to shine. The shining light attracts its comrades, and they stand together against their enemies.

name: mareanie
entry: It plunges the poison spike on its head into its prey. When the prey has weakened, Mareanie deals the finishing blow with its 10 tentacles.

name: toxapex
entry: Toxapex crawls along the ocean floor on its 12 legs. It leaves a trail of Corsola bits scattered in its wake.

name: mudbray
entry: The mud stuck to Mudbray’s hooves enhances its grip and its powerful running gait.

name: mudsdale
entry: It spits a mud that provides resistance to both wind and rain, so the walls of old houses were often coated with it.

name: dewpider
entry: It crawls onto the land in search of food. Its water bubble allows it to breathe and protects its soft head.

name: araquanid
entry: It delivers headbutts with the water bubble on its head. Small Pokémon get sucked into the bubble, where they drown.

name: fomantis
entry: During the day, it sleeps and soaks up light. When night falls, it walks around looking for a safer place to sleep.

name: lurantis
entry: It requires a lot of effort to maintain Lurantis’s vivid coloring, but some collectors enjoy this work and treat it as their hobby.

name: morelull
entry: It scatters spores that flicker and glow. Anyone seeing these lights falls into a deep slumber.

name: shiinotic
entry: Forests where Shiinotic live are treacherous to enter at night. People confused by its strange lights can never find their way home again.

name: salandit
entry: It burns its bodily fluids to create a poisonous gas. When its enemies become disoriented from inhaling the gas, it attacks them.

name: salazzle
entry: For some reason, only females have been found. It creates a reverse harem of male Salandit that it lives with.

name: stufful
entry: Despite its adorable appearance, when it gets angry and flails about, its arms and legs could knock a pro wrestler sprawling.

name: bewear
entry: This immensely dangerous Pokémon possesses overwhelming physical strength. Its habitat is generally off-limits.

name: bounsweet
entry: Because of its sweet, delicious aroma, bird Pokémon are always after it, but it’s not intelligent enough to care.

name: steenee
entry: The sepals on its head developed to protect its body. These are quite hard, so even if pecked by bird Pokémon, this Pokémon is totally fine.

name: tsareena
entry: Its long, striking legs aren’t just for show but to be used to kick with skill. In victory, it shows off by kicking the defeated, laughing boisterously.

name: comfey
entry: It attaches flowers to its highly nutritious vine. This revitalizes the flowers, and they give off an aromatic scent.

name: oranguru
entry: Known for its extreme intelligence, this Pokémon will look down on inexperienced Trainers, so it’s best suited to veteran Trainers.

name: passimian
entry: They form groups of roughly 20 individuals. Their mutual bond is remarkable—they will never let down a comrade.

name: wimpod
entry: This Pokémon is a coward. As it desperately dashes off, the flailing of its many legs leaves a sparkling clean path in its wake.

name: golisopod
entry: With a flashing slash of its giant sharp claws, it cleaves seawater—or even air—right in two.

name: sandygast
entry: Born from a sand mound playfully built by a child, this Pokémon embodies the grudges of the departed.

name: palossand
entry: Possessed people controlled by this Pokémon transformed its sand mound into a castle. As it evolved, its power to curse grew ever stronger.

name: pyukumuku
entry: It lives in shallow seas, such as areas near a beach. It can eject its internal organs, which it uses to engulf its prey or battle enemies.

name: type-null
entry: The heavy control mask it wears suppresses its intrinsic capabilities. This Pokémon has some hidden special power.

name: silvally
entry: Its trust in its partner is what awakens it. This Pokémon is capable of changing its type, a flexibility that is well displayed in battle.

name: minior-red-meteor
entry: Originally making its home in the ozone layer, it hurtles to the ground when the shell enclosing its body grows too heavy.

name: komala
entry: It is born asleep, and it dies asleep. All its movements are apparently no more than the results of it tossing and turning in its dreams.

name: turtonator
entry: The shell on its back is chemically unstable and explodes violently if struck. The hole in its stomach is its weak point.

name: togedemaru
entry: The spiny fur on its back is normally at rest. When this Pokémon becomes agitated, its fur stands on end and stabs into its attackers.

name: mimikyu-disguised
entry: Its actual appearance is unknown. A scholar who saw what was under its rag was overwhelmed by terror and died from the shock.

name: bruxish
entry: When it unleashes its psychic power from the protuberance on its head, the grating sound of grinding teeth echoes through the area.

name: drampa
entry: It has a compassionate personality, but if it is angered, it completely destroys its surroundings with its intense breath.

name: dhelmise
entry: Swinging its massive anchor, it can KO Wailord in a single blow. What appears to be green seaweed is actually its body.

name: jangmo-o
entry: It expresses its feelings by smacking its scales. Metallic sounds echo through the tall mountains where Jangmo-o lives.

name: hakamo-o
entry: It leaps at its prey with a courageous shout. Its scaly punches tear its opponents to shreds.

name: kommo-o
entry: When it spots enemies, it threatens them by jingling the scales on its tail. Weak opponents will crack and flee in panic.

name: tapu-koko
entry: This guardian deity of Melemele is brimming with curiosity. It summons thunderclouds and stores their lightning inside its body.

name: tapu-lele
entry: This guardian deity of Akala is guilelessly cruel. The fragrant aroma of flowers is the source of its energy.

name: tapu-bulu
entry: It pulls large trees up by the roots and swings them around. It causes vegetation to grow, and then it absorbs energy from the growth.

name: tapu-fini
entry: The dense fog it creates brings the downfall and destruction of its confused enemies. Ocean currents are the source of its energy.

name: cosmog
entry: Its body is gaseous and frail. It slowly grows as it collects dust from the atmosphere.

name: cosmoem
entry: Motionless as if dead, its body is faintly warm to the touch. In the distant past, it was called the cocoon of the stars.

name: solgaleo
entry: It is said to live in another world. The intense light it radiates from the surface of its body can make the darkest of nights light up like midday.

name: lunala
entry: It is said to be a female evolution of Cosmog. When its third eye activates, away it flies to another world.

name: nihilego
entry: One of several mysterious Ultra Beasts. People on the street report observing those infested by it suddenly becoming violent.

name: buzzwole
entry: This Ultra Beast appeared from another world. It shows off its body, but whether that display is a boast or a threat remains unclear.

name: pheromosa
entry: One of the dangerous Ultra Beasts, it has been spotted running across the land at terrific speeds.

name: xurkitree
entry: One of the mysterious life-forms known as Ultra Beasts. Astonishing electric shocks emanate from its entire body, according to witnesses.

name: celesteela
entry: It appeared from the Ultra Wormhole. Witnesses observed it flying across the sky at high speed.

name: kartana
entry: This Ultra Beast came from the Ultra Wormhole. It seems not to attack enemies on its own, but its sharp body is a dangerous weapon in itself.

name: guzzlord
entry: It has gobbled mountains and swallowed whole buildings, according to reports. It’s one of the Ultra Beasts.

name: necrozma
entry: Reminiscent of the Ultra Beasts, this life-form, apparently asleep underground, is thought to have come from another world in ancient times.

name: magearna
entry: This artificial Pokémon, constructed more than 500 years ago, can understand human speech but cannot itself speak.

name: marshadow
entry: Able to conceal itself in shadows, it never appears before humans, so its very existence was the stuff of myth.

name: poipole
entry: This Ultra Beast is well enough liked to be chosen as a first partner in its own world.

name: naganadel
entry: It stores hundreds of liters of poisonous liquid inside its body. It is one of the organisms known as UBs.

name: stakataka
entry: It appeared from an Ultra Wormhole. Each one appears to be made up of many life-forms stacked one on top of each other.

name: blacephalon
entry: It slithers toward people. Then, without warning, it triggers the explosion of its own head. It’s apparently one kind of Ultra Beast.

name: zeraora
entry: It electrifies its claws and tears its opponents apart with them. Even if they dodge its attack, they’ll be electrocuted by the flying sparks.

name: meltan
entry: It melts particles of iron and other metals found in the subsoil, so it can absorb them into its body of molten steel.

name: melmetal
entry: Revered long ago for its capacity to create iron from nothing, for some reason it has come back to life after 3,000 years.

name: grookey
entry: When it uses its special stick to strike up a beat, the sound waves produced carry revitalizing energy to the plants and flowers in the area.

name: thwackey
entry: The faster a Thwackey can beat out a rhythm with its two sticks, the more respect it wins from its peers.

name: rillaboom
entry: By drumming, it taps into the power of its special tree stump. The roots of the stump follow its direction in battle.

name: scorbunny
entry: A warm-up of running around gets fire energy coursing through this Pokémon’s body. Once that happens, it’s ready to fight at full power.

name: raboot
entry: Its thick and fluffy fur protects it from the cold and enables it to use hotter fire moves.

name: cinderace
entry: It juggles a pebble with its feet, turning it into a burning soccer ball. Its shots strike opponents hard and leave them scorched.

name: sobble
entry: When scared, this Pokémon cries. Its tears pack the chemical punch of 100 onions, and attackers won’t be able to resist weeping.

name: drizzile
entry: A clever combatant, this Pokémon battles using water balloons created with moisture secreted from its palms.

name: inteleon
entry: It has many hidden capabilities, such as fingertips that can shoot water and a membrane on its back that it can use to glide through the air.

name: skwovet
entry: Found throughout the Galar region, this Pokémon becomes uneasy if its cheeks are ever completely empty of berries.

name: greedent
entry: It stashes berries in its tail—so many berries that they fall out constantly. But this Pokémon is a bit slow-witted, so it doesn’t notice the loss.

name: rookidee
entry: It will bravely challenge any opponent, no matter how powerful. This Pokémon benefits from every battle—even a defeat increases its strength a bit.

name: corvisquire
entry: Smart enough to use tools in battle, these Pokémon have been seen picking up rocks and flinging them or using ropes to wrap up enemies.

name: corviknight
entry: This Pokémon reigns supreme in the skies of the Galar region. The black luster of its steel body could drive terror into the heart of any foe.

name: blipbug
entry: A constant collector of information, this Pokémon is very smart. Very strong is what it isn’t.

name: dottler
entry: It barely moves, but it’s still alive. Hiding in its shell without food or water seems to have awakened its psychic powers.

name: orbeetle
entry: It’s famous for its high level of intelligence, and the large size of its brain is proof that it also possesses immense psychic power.

name: nickit
entry: Aided by the soft pads on its feet, it silently raids the food stores of other Pokémon. It survives off its ill-gotten gains.

name: thievul
entry: It secretly marks potential targets with a scent. By following the scent, it stalks its targets and steals from them when they least expect it.

name: gossifleur
entry: It anchors itself in the ground with its single leg, then basks in the sun. After absorbing enough sunlight, its petals spread as it blooms brilliantly.

name: eldegoss
entry: The seeds attached to its cotton fluff are full of nutrients. It spreads them on the wind so that plants and other Pokémon can benefit from them.

name: wooloo
entry: Its curly fleece is such an effective cushion that this Pokémon could fall off a cliff and stand right back up at the bottom, unharmed.

name: dubwool
entry: Weave a carpet from its springy wool, and you end up with something closer to a trampoline. You’ll start to bounce the moment you set foot on it.

name: chewtle
entry: Apparently the itch of its teething impels it to snap its jaws at anything in front of it.

name: drednaw
entry: With jaws that can shear through steel rods, this highly aggressive Pokémon chomps down on its unfortunate prey.

name: yamper
entry: This Pokémon is very popular as a herding dog in the Galar region. As it runs, it generates electricity from the base of its tail.

name: boltund
entry: This Pokémon generates electricity and channels it into its legs to keep them going strong. Boltund can run nonstop for three full days.

name: rolycoly
entry: Most of its body has the same composition as coal. Fittingly, this Pokémon was first discovered in coal mines about 400 years ago.

name: carkol
entry: It forms coal inside its body. Coal dropped by this Pokémon once helped fuel the lives of people in the Galar region.

name: coalossal
entry: It’s usually peaceful, but the vandalism of mines enrages it. Offenders will be incinerated with flames that reach 2,700 degrees Fahrenheit.

name: applin
entry: It spends its entire life inside an apple. It hides from its natural enemies, bird Pokémon, by pretending it’s just an apple and nothing more.

name: flapple
entry: It ate a sour apple, and that induced its evolution. In its cheeks, it stores an acid capable of causing chemical burns.

name: appletun
entry: Eating a sweet apple caused its evolution. A nectarous scent wafts from its body, luring in the bug Pokémon it preys on.

name: silicobra
entry: As it digs, it swallows sand and stores it in its neck pouch. The pouch can hold more than 17 pounds of sand.

name: sandaconda
entry: When it contracts its body, over 220 pounds of sand sprays from its nose. If it ever runs out of sand, it becomes disheartened.

name: cramorant
entry: It’s so strong that it can knock out some opponents in a single hit, but it also may forget what it’s battling midfight.

name: arrokuda
entry: If it sees any movement around it, this Pokémon charges for it straightaway, leading with its sharply pointed jaw. It’s very proud of that jaw.

name: barraskewda
entry: This Pokémon has a jaw that’s as sharp as a spear and as strong as steel. Apparently Barraskewda’s flesh is surprisingly tasty, too.

name: toxel
entry: It stores poison in an internal poison sac and secretes that poison through its skin. If you touch this Pokémon, a tingling sensation follows.

name: toxtricity-amped
entry: When this Pokémon sounds as if it’s strumming a guitar, it’s actually clawing at the protrusions on its chest to generate electricity.

name: sizzlipede
entry: It stores flammable gas in its body and uses it to generate heat. The yellow sections on its belly get particularly hot.

name: centiskorch
entry: When it heats up, its body temperature reaches about 1,500 degrees Fahrenheit. It lashes its body like a whip and launches itself at enemies.

name: clobbopus
entry: It’s very curious, but its means of investigating things is to try to punch them with its tentacles. The search for food is what brings it onto land.

name: grapploct
entry: A body made up of nothing but muscle makes the grappling moves this Pokémon performs with its tentacles tremendously powerful.

name: sinistea
entry: This Pokémon is said to have been born when a lonely spirit possessed a cold, leftover cup of tea.

name: polteageist
entry: This species lives in antique teapots. Most pots are forgeries, but on rare occasions, an authentic work is found.

name: hatenna
entry: Via the protrusion on its head, it senses other creatures’ emotions. If you don’t have a calm disposition, it will never warm up to you.

name: hattrem
entry: No matter who you are, if you bring strong emotions near this Pokémon, it will silence you violently.

name: hatterene
entry: It emits psychic power strong enough to cause headaches as a deterrent to the approach of others.

name: impidimp
entry: Through its nose, it sucks in the emanations produced by people and Pokémon when they feel annoyed. It thrives off this negative energy.

name: morgrem
entry: When it gets down on all fours as if to beg for forgiveness, it’s trying to lure opponents in so that it can stab them with its spear-like hair.

name: grimmsnarl
entry: With the hair wrapped around its body helping to enhance its muscles, this Pokémon can overwhelm even Machamp.

name: obstagoon
entry: Its voice is staggering in volume. Obstagoon has a tendency to take on a threatening posture and shout—this move is known as Obstruct.

name: perrserker
entry: What appears to be an iron helmet is actually hardened hair. This Pokémon lives for the thrill of battle.

name: cursola
entry: Its shell is overflowing with its heightened otherworldly energy. The ectoplasm serves as protection for this Pokémon’s core spirit.

name: sirfetchd
entry: Only Farfetch’d that have survived many battles can attain this evolution. When this Pokémon’s leek withers, it will retire from combat.

name: mr-rime
entry: It’s highly skilled at tap-dancing. It waves its cane of ice in time with its graceful movements.

name: runerigus
entry: A powerful curse was woven into an ancient painting. After absorbing the spirit of a Yamask, the painting began to move.

name: milcery
entry: This Pokémon was born from sweet-smelling particles in the air. Its body is made of cream.

name: alcremie
entry: When it trusts a Trainer, it will treat them to berries it’s decorated with cream.

name: falinks
entry: Five of them are troopers, and one is the brass. The brass’s orders are absolute.

name: pincurchin
entry: It feeds on seaweed, using its teeth to scrape it off rocks. Electric current flows from the tips of its spines.

name: snom
entry: It spits out thread imbued with a frigid sort of energy and uses it to tie its body to branches, disguising itself as an icicle while it sleeps.

name: frosmoth
entry: Icy scales fall from its wings like snow as it flies over fields and mountains. The temperature of its wings is less than −290 degrees Fahrenheit.

name: stonjourner
entry: It stands in grasslands, watching the sun’s descent from zenith to horizon. This Pokémon has a talent for delivering dynamic kicks.

name: eiscue-ice
entry: It drifted in on the flow of ocean waters from a frigid place. It keeps its head iced constantly to make sure it stays nice and cold.

name: indeedee-male
entry: It uses the horns on its head to sense the emotions of others. Males will act as valets for those they serve, looking after their every need.

name: morpeko-full-belly
entry: As it eats the seeds stored up in its pocket-like pouches, this Pokémon is not just satisfying its constant hunger. It’s also generating electricity.

name: cufant
entry: It digs up the ground with its trunk. It’s also very strong, being able to carry loads of over five tons without any problem at all.

name: copperajah
entry: They came over from another region long ago and worked together with humans. Their green skin is resistant to water.

name: dracozolt
entry: In ancient times, it was unbeatable thanks to its powerful lower body, but it went extinct anyway after it depleted all its plant-based food sources.

name: arctozolt
entry: The shaking of its freezing upper half is what generates its electricity. It has a hard time walking around.

name: dracovish
entry: Powerful legs and jaws made it the apex predator of its time. Its own overhunting of its prey was what drove it to extinction.

name: arctovish
entry: Though it’s able to capture prey by freezing its surroundings, it has trouble eating the prey afterward because its mouth is on top of its head.

name: duraludon
entry: Its body resembles polished metal, and it’s both lightweight and strong. The only drawback is that it rusts easily.

name: dreepy
entry: After being reborn as a ghost Pokémon, Dreepy wanders the areas it used to inhabit back when it was alive in prehistoric seas.

name: drakloak
entry: It’s capable of flying faster than 120 mph. It battles alongside Dreepy and dotes on them until they successfully evolve.

name: dragapult
entry: When it isn’t battling, it keeps Dreepy in the holes on its horns. Once a fight starts, it launches the Dreepy like supersonic missiles.

name: zacian
entry: Known as a legendary hero, this Pokémon absorbs metal particles, transforming them into a weapon it uses to battle.

name: zamazenta
entry: In times past, it worked together with a king of the people to save the Galar region. It absorbs metal that it then uses in battle.

name: eternatus
entry: The core on its chest absorbs energy emanating from the lands of the Galar region. This energy is what allows Eternatus to stay active.

name: kubfu
entry: Kubfu trains hard to perfect its moves. The moves it masters will determine which form it takes when it evolves.

name: urshifu-single-strike
entry: This form of Urshifu is a strong believer in the one-hit KO. Its strategy is to leap in close to foes and land a devastating blow with a hardened fist.

name: zarude
entry: Within dense forests, this Pokémon lives in a pack with others of its kind. It’s incredibly aggressive, and the other Pokémon of the forest fear it.

name: regieleki
entry: This Pokémon is a cluster of electrical energy. It’s said that removing the rings on Regieleki’s body will unleash the Pokémon’s latent power.

name: regidrago
entry: An academic theory proposes that Regidrago’s arms were once the head of an ancient dragon Pokémon. The theory remains unproven.

name: glastrier
entry: Glastrier emits intense cold from its hooves. It’s also a belligerent Pokémon—anything it wants, it takes by force.

name: spectrier
entry: It probes its surroundings with all its senses save one—it doesn’t use its sense of sight. Spectrier’s kicks are said to separate soul from body.

name: calyrex
entry: Calyrex is a merciful Pokémon, capable of providing healing and blessings. It reigned over the Galar region in times of yore.

name: wyrdeer
entry: The black orbs shine with an uncanny light when the Pokémon is erecting invisible barriers. The fur shed from its beard retains heat well and is a highly useful material for winter clothing.

name: kleavor
entry: A violent creature that fells towering trees with its crude axes and shields itself with hard stone. If one should chance upon this Pokémon in the wilds, one's only recourse is to flee.

name: ursaluna
entry: I believe it was Hisui's swampy terrain that gave Ursaluna its burly physique and newfound capacity to manipulate peat at will.

name: basculegion-male
entry: Clads itself in the souls of comrades that perished before fulfilling their goals of journeying upstream. No other species throughout all Hisui's rivers is Basculegion's equal.

name: sneasler
entry: Because of Sneasler's virulent poison and daunting physical prowess, no other species could hope to best it on the frozen highlands. Preferring solitude, this species does not form packs.

name: overqwil
entry: Its lancelike spikes and savage temperament have earned it the nickname ”sea fiend.” It slurps up poison to nourish itself.

name: enamorus-incarnate
entry: When it flies to this land from across the sea, the bitter winter comes to an end. According to legend, this Pokémon's love gives rise to the budding of fresh life across Hisui.

name: sprigatito
entry: Its fluffy fur is similar in composition to plants. This Pokémon frequently washes its face to keep it from drying out.

name: floragato
entry: Floragato deftly wields the vine hidden beneath its long fur, slamming the hard flower bud against its opponents.

name: meowscarada
entry: This Pokémon uses the reflective fur lining its cape to camouflage the stem of its flower, creating the illusion that the flower is floating.

name: fuecoco
entry: It lies on warm rocks and uses the heat absorbed by its square-shaped scales to create fire energy.

name: crocalor
entry: The combination of Crocalor’s fire energy and overflowing vitality has caused an egg-shaped fireball to appear on the Pokémon’s head.

name: skeledirge
entry: The fiery bird changes shape when Skeledirge sings. Rumor has it that the bird was born when the fireball on Skeledirge’s head gained a soul.

name: quaxly
entry: This Pokémon migrated to Paldea from distant lands long ago. The gel secreted by its feathers repels water and grime."

name: quaxwell
entry: These Pokémon constantly run through shallow waters to train their legs, then compete with each other to see which of them kicks most gracefully.

name: quaquaval
entry: A single kick from a Quaquaval can send a truck rolling. This Pokémon uses its powerful legs to perform striking dances from far-off lands.

name: lechonk
entry: It searches for food all day. It possesses a keen sense of smell but doesn’t use it for anything other than foraging.

name: oinkologne-male
entry: Oinkologne is proud of its fine, glossy skin. It emits a concentrated scent from the tip of its tail.

name: tarountula
entry: The ball of threads wrapped around its body is elastic enough to deflect the scythes of Scyther, this Pokémon’s natural enemy.

name: spidops
entry: It clings to branches and ceilings using its threads and moves without a sound. It takes out its prey before the prey even notices it.

name: nymble
entry: It has its third set of legs folded up. When it’s in a tough spot, this Pokémon jumps over 30 feet using the strength of its legs.

name: lokix
entry: When it decides to fight all out, it stands on its previously folded legs to enter Showdown Mode. It neutralizes its enemies in short order.

name: pawmi
entry: It has underdeveloped electric sacs on its cheeks. These sacs can produce electricity only if Pawmi rubs them furiously with the pads on its forepaws.

name: pawmo
entry: When its group is attacked, Pawmo is the first to leap into battle, defeating enemies with a fighting technique that utilizes electric shocks.

name: pawmot
entry: This Pokémon normally is slow to react, but once it enters battle, it will strike down its enemies with lightning-fast movements.

name: tandemaus
entry: Exhibiting great teamwork, they use their incisors to cut pieces out of any material that might be useful for a nest, then make off with them.

name: maushold-family-of-four
entry: The two little ones just appeared one day. The group might be a family of related Pokémon, but nobody knows for sure.

name: fidough
entry: This Pokémon is smooth and moist to the touch. Yeast in Fidough’s breath induces fermentation in the Pokémon’s vicinity.

name: dachsbun
entry: The pleasant aroma that emanates from this Pokémon’s body helps wheat grow, so Dachsbun has been treasured by farming villages.

name: smoliv
entry: It protects itself from enemies by emitting oil from the fruit on its head. This oil is bitter and astringent enough to make someone flinch.

name: dolliv
entry: Dolliv shares its tasty, fresh-scented oil with others. This species has coexisted with humans since times long gone.

name: arboliva
entry: This calm Pokémon is very compassionate. It will share its delicious, nutrient-rich oil with weakened Pokémon.

name: squawkabilly-green-plumage
entry: These Pokémon prefer to live in cities. They form flocks based on the color of their feathers, and they fight over territory.

name: nacli
entry: It was born in a layer of rock salt deep under the earth. This species was particularly treasured in the old days, as they would share precious salt.

name: naclstack
entry: This Pokémon dry cures its prey by spraying salt over them. The curing process steals away the water in the prey’s body.

name: garganacl
entry: Garganacl will rub its fingertips together and sprinkle injured Pokémon with salt. Even severe wounds will promptly heal afterward.

name: charcadet
entry: Burnt charcoal came to life and became a Pokémon. Possessing a fiery fighting spirit, Charcadet will battle even tough opponents.

name: armarouge
entry: Armarouge evolved through the use of a set of armor that belonged to a distinguished warrior. This Pokémon is incredibly loyal.

name: ceruledge
entry: The fiery blades on its arms burn fiercely with the lingering resentment of a sword wielder who fell before accomplishing their goal.

name: tadbulb
entry: Tadbulb shakes its tail to generate electricity. If it senses danger, it will make its head blink on and off to alert its allies.

name: bellibolt
entry: When this Pokémon expands and contracts its wobbly body, the belly-button dynamo in its stomach produces a huge amount of electricity.

name: wattrel
entry: When its wings catch the wind, the bones within produce electricity. This Pokémon dives into the ocean, catching prey by electrocuting them.

name: kilowattrel
entry: Kilowattrel inflates its throat sac to amplify its electricity. By riding the wind, this Pokémon can fly over 430 miles in a day.

name: maschiff
entry: It always scowls in an attempt to make opponents take it seriously, but even crying children will burst into laughter when they see Maschiff’s face.

name: mabosstiff
entry: This Pokémon can store energy in its large dewlap. Mabosstiff unleashes this energy all at once to blow away enemies.

name: shroodle
entry: Though usually a mellow Pokémon, it will sink its sharp, poison-soaked front teeth into any that anger it, causing paralysis in the object of its ire.

name: grafaiai
entry: The color of the poisonous saliva depends on what the Pokémon eats. Grafaiai covers its fingers in its saliva and draws patterns on trees in forests.

name: bramblin
entry: A soul unable to move on to the afterlife was blown around by the wind until it got tangled up with dried grass and became a Pokémon.

name: brambleghast
entry: It will open the branches of its head to envelop its prey. Once it absorbs all the life energy it needs, it expels the prey and discards it.

name: toedscool
entry: Toedscool lives in muggy forests. The flaps that fall from its body are chewy and very delicious.

name: toedscruel
entry: These Pokémon gather into groups and form colonies deep within forests. They absolutely hate it when strangers approach.

name: klawf
entry: Klawf hangs upside-down from cliffs, waiting for prey. But Klawf can’t remain in this position for long because its blood rushes to its head.

name: capsakid
entry: The more sunlight this Pokémon bathes in, the more spicy chemicals are produced by its body, and thus the spicier its moves become.

name: scovillain
entry: The red head converts spicy chemicals into fire energy and blasts the surrounding area with a super spicy stream of flame.

name: rellor
entry: This Pokémon creates a mud ball by mixing sand and dirt with psychic energy. It treasures its mud ball more than its own life.

name: rabsca
entry: The body that supports the ball barely moves. Therefore, it is thought that the true body of this Pokémon is actually inside the ball.

name: flittle
entry: Flittle’s toes levitate about half an inch above the ground because of the psychic power emitted from the frills on the Pokémon’s belly.

name: espathra
entry: It immobilizes opponents by bathing them in psychic power from its large eyes. Despite its appearance, it has a vicious temperament.

name: tinkatink
entry: It swings its handmade hammer around to protect itself, but the hammer is often stolen by Pokémon that eat metal.

name: tinkatuff
entry: This Pokémon will attack groups of Pawniard and Bisharp, gathering metal from them in order to create a large and sturdy hammer.

name: tinkaton
entry: This intelligent Pokémon has a very daring disposition. It knocks rocks into the sky with its hammer, aiming for flying Corviknight.

name: wiglett
entry: This Pokémon can pick up the scent of a Veluza just over 65 feet away and will hide itself in the sand.

name: wugtrio
entry: It has a vicious temperament, contrary to what its appearance may suggest. It wraps its long bodies around prey, then drags the prey into its den.

name: bombirdier
entry: It gathers things up in an apron made from shed feathers added to the Pokémon’s chest feathers, then drops those things from high places for fun.

name: finizen
entry: It likes playing with others of its kind using the water ring on its tail. It uses ultrasonic waves to sense the emotions of other living creatures.

name: palafin-zero
entry: This Pokémon changes its appearance if it hears its allies calling for help. Palafin will never show anybody its moment of transformation.

name: varoom
entry: It is said that this Pokémon was born when an unknown poison Pokémon entered and inspirited an engine left at a scrap-processing factory.

name: revavroom
entry: It creates a gas out of poison and minerals from rocks. It then detonates the gas in its cylinders—now numbering eight—to generate energy.

name: cyclizar
entry: Apparently Cyclizar has been allowing people to ride on its back since ancient times. Depictions of this have been found in 10,000-year-old murals.

name: orthworm
entry: When attacked, this Pokémon will wield the tendrils on its body like fists and pelt the opponent with a storm of punches.

name: glimmet
entry: It absorbs nutrients from cave walls. The petals it wears are made of crystallized poison.

name: glimmora
entry: When this Pokémon detects danger, it will open up its crystalline petals and fire beams from its conical body.

name: greavard
entry: It is said that a dog Pokémon that died in the wild without ever interacting with a human was reborn as this Pokémon.

name: houndstone
entry: Houndstone spends most of its time sleeping in graveyards. Among all the dog Pokémon, this one is most loyal to its master.

name: flamigo
entry: This Pokémon apparently ties the base of its neck into a knot so that energy stored in its belly does not escape from its beak.

name: cetoddle
entry: This species left the ocean and began living on land a very long time ago. It seems to be closely related to Wailmer.

name: cetitan
entry: This Pokémon wanders around snowy, icy areas. It protects its body with powerful muscles and a thick layer of fat under its skin.

name: veluza
entry: When Veluza discards unnecessary flesh, its mind becomes honed and its psychic power increases. The spare flesh has a mild but delicious flavor.

name: dondozo
entry: This Pokémon is a glutton, but it’s bad at getting food. It teams up with a Tatsugiri to catch prey.

name: tatsugiri-curly
entry: This is a small dragon Pokémon. It lives inside the mouth of Dondozo to protect itself from enemies on the outside.

name: annihilape
entry: When its anger rose beyond a critical point, this Pokémon gained power that is unfettered by the limits of its physical body.

name: clodsire
entry: When attacked, this Pokémon will retaliate by sticking thick spines out from its body. It’s a risky move that puts everything on the line.

name: farigiraf
entry: Now that the brain waves from the head and tail are synced up, the psychic power of this Pokémon is 10 times stronger than Girafarig’s.

name: dudunsparce-two-segment
entry: This Pokémon uses its hard tail to make its nest by boring holes into bedrock deep underground. The nest can reach lengths of over six miles.

name: kingambit
entry: Only a Bisharp that stands above all others in its vast army can evolve into Kingambit.

name: great-tusk
entry: Sightings of this Pokémon have occurred in recent years. The name Great Tusk was taken from a creature listed in a certain book.

name: scream-tail
entry: There has been only one reported sighting of this Pokémon. It resembles a mysterious creature depicted in an old expedition journal.

name: brute-bonnet
entry: It is possible that the creature listed as Brute Bonnet in a certain book could actually be this Pokémon.

name: flutter-mane
entry: This Pokémon has characteristics similar to those of Flutter Mane, a creature mentioned in a certain book.

name: slither-wing
entry: This mysterious Pokémon has some similarities to a creature that an old book introduced as Slither Wing.

name: sandy-shocks
entry: No records exist of this Pokémon being caught. Data is lacking, but the Pokémon’s traits match up with a creature shown in an expedition journal.

name: iron-treads
entry: This Pokémon closely resembles a scientific weapon that a paranormal magazine claimed was sent to this planet by aliens.

name: iron-bundle
entry: Its shape is similar to a robot featured in a paranormal magazine article. The robot was said to have been created by an ancient civilization.

name: iron-hands
entry: It is very similar to a cyborg covered exclusively by a paranormal magazine. The cyborg was said to be the modified form of a certain athlete.

name: iron-jugulis
entry: It resembles a certain Pokémon introduced in a paranormal magazine, described as the offspring of a Hydreigon that fell in love with a robot.

name: iron-moth
entry: This Pokémon resembles an unknown object described in a paranormal magazine as a UFO sent to observe humanity.

name: iron-thorns
entry: It has some similarities to a Pokémon introduced in a dubious magazine as a Tyranitar from one billion years into the future.

name: frigibax
entry: Frigibax absorbs heat through its dorsal fin and converts the heat into ice energy. The higher the temperature, the more energy Frigibax stores.

name: arctibax
entry: Arctibax freezes the air around it, protecting its face with an ice mask and turning its dorsal fin into a blade of ice.

name: baxcalibur
entry: This Pokémon blasts cryogenic air out from its mouth. This air can instantly freeze even liquid-hot lava.

name: gimmighoul
entry: This Pokémon was born inside a treasure chest about 1,500 years ago. It sucks the life-force out of scoundrels who try to steal the treasure.

name: gholdengo
entry: Its body seems to be made up of 1,000 coins. This Pokémon gets along well with others and is quick to make friends with anybody.

name: wo-chien
entry: The grudge of a person punished for writing the king’s evil deeds upon wooden tablets has clad itself in dead leaves to become a Pokémon.

name: chien-pao
entry: This Pokémon can control 100 tons of fallen snow. It plays around innocently by leaping in and out of avalanches it has caused.

name: ting-lu
entry: The fear poured into an ancient ritual vessel has clad itself in rocks and dirt to become a Pokémon.

name: chi-yu
entry: It controls flames burning at over 5,400 degrees Fahrenheit. It casually swims through the sea of lava it creates by melting rock and sand.

name: roaring-moon
entry: It is possible that this is the creature listed as Roaring Moon in an expedition journal that still holds many mysteries.

name: iron-valiant
entry: It has some similarities to a mad scientist’s invention covered in a paranormal magazine.

name: koraidon
entry: This seems to be the Winged King mentioned in an old expedition journal. It was said to have split the land with its bare fists.

name: miraidon
entry: Much remains unknown about this creature. It resembles Cyclizar, but it is far more ruthless and powerful.

name: walking-wake
entry: This ferocious creature is shrouded in mystery. It's named after an aquatic monster mentioned in an old expedition journal.

name: iron-leaves
entry: Many of its physical characteristics match those of a Virizion from the future that was covered in a paranormal magazine.

name: dipplin
entry: Dipplin is two creatures in one Pokémon. Its evolution was triggered by a special apple grown only in one place.

name: poltchageist
entry: Supposedly, the regrets of a tea ceremony master who died before perfecting his craft lingered in some matcha and became a Pokémon.

name: sinistcha
entry: It pretends to be tea, trying to fool people into drinking it so it can drain their life-force. Its ruse is generally unsuccessful.

name: okidogi
entry: After all its muscles were stimulated by the toxic chain around its neck, Okidogi transformed and gained a powerful physique.

name: munkidori
entry: The chain is made from toxins that enhance capabilities. It stimulated Munkidori's brain and caused the Pokémon's psychic powers to bloom.

name: fezandipiti
entry: Fezandipiti owes its beautiful looks and lovely voice to the toxic stimulants emanating from the chain wrapped around its body.

name: ogerpon
entry: This Pokémon's type changes based on which mask it's wearing. It confounds its enemies with nimble movements and kicks.

name: archaludon
entry: It gathers static electricity from its surroundings. The beams it launches when down on all fours are tremendously powerful.

name: hydrapple
entry: Seven syrpents live inside an apple made of syrup. The syrpent in the center is the commander.

name: gouging-fire
entry: There are scant few reports of this creature being sighted. One short video shows it rampaging and spouting pillars of flame.

name: raging-bolt
entry: It's said to incinerate everything around it with lightning launched from its fur. Very little is known about this creature.

name: iron-boulder
entry: It resembles a Pokémon described in a dubious magazine as a Terrakion that had been modified by an evil organization.

name: iron-crown
entry: It resembles a mysterious object introduced in a paranormal magazine as a cutting-edge weapon shaped like a Cobalion.

name: terapagos
entry: Terapagos protects itself using its power to transform energy into hard crystals. This Pokémon is the source of the Terastal phenomenon.

name: pecharunt
entry: It feeds others toxic mochi that draw out desires and capabilities. Those who eat the mochi fall under Pecharunt’s control, chained to its will.
